newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close higher on technicals.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close higher on technicals.

text.p: Pakistani stocks gained at Friday's close on a technical correction and dealers said the rally would continue for the next few days because the Karachi 100-share index had come down to an attractive level.
"The index was under pressure because of economic worries and now it's time for a correction," dealer Zubair Ilhai said. "The index will jump 1,600 points in the next couple of days."
The index rose 14.90 points, or 0.95 percent, to end at 1,590.19. Gainers beat losers 148 to 119. Fauji Fertilizer rose 2.0 rupees to 80 and Hub Power 0.25 to 38.65.
